description: Albert Cuypstraat 152-164 (1892-93): 6 m fronts of a tall shop and three upper storeys of red-brown brick; three axes of white T-windows under flat brick heads with white sills; iron wall anchors on the piers; a brick frieze with small white lozenges under a white cornice at 14.0 m; one white pediment dormer with a hoist beam over the middle axis

match.note: Albert Cuypstraat 152-162 (1892-93); cornice 14.0 m on the 2022-03-21 strip

pediment-dormer.note: 152-162: one white dormer 1.6 m wide over the middle axis, 14.2-16.5 m, pediment and hoist beam

door-left.note: a residential door at the left party wall beside the shop

rhythm.roofline: brick frieze with white lozenges, white cornice at 14.0 m, one pediment dormer with a hoist beam
schemaLimits: the white lozenges in the frieze are not drawn
